direction_conventions.exposure: exposed node loses value when source node is distressed

coverage.note: All 500 S&P companies are nodes. Links: hand review (candidate pairs ranked 1-80, plus EDGAR full-text search of other companies' filings), curated demo links, 13F, XBRL named customers, and rule-based classification of the remaining evidence (unreviewed).

overseas.note: Foreign counterparties are tagged by region only (from the country field, the review, or legal-name patterns such as GmbH, K.K., Pte. Ltd.); they were not researched from their own side. S&P members count as US.

display_tiers.core: S&P 500 companies, curated counterparties, and every node in the model
display_tiers.peripheral: companies only in display-only links; hide by default

field_notes.has_estimated_weight: links: true when the demand weight basis is a judgment call (prior_estimate, type_prior, default_prior, buyer_dependence_prior), a split group figure (disclosed_combined_group_share), a lower bound (disclosed_lower_bound), or the link is news-only. null for links that do not propagate.
field_notes.is_estimated: exposures: same rule; supply-channel weights are judgment calls unless basis is disclosed_reliance.
field_notes.source_tier: evidence (new): 1 = SEC filing or a party's own announcement, 2 = Reuters/AP/WSJ/FT/Bloomberg/CNBC, 3 = trade press (corroboration only).
